artist.name: Rufy Ghazi
artist.bio: Rufy Ghazi, who DJs as Lady Ruffelin, is a London based DJ and music business professional who hosted Lady Ruffelin's Escape, a festival themed show, on boxout.fm in 2017. She has played Magnetic Fields, Mixmag LAB and Bass Camp, with sets across grime, drum and bass, UK garage, breakbeat and leftfield.
